Explicit new intention or edited content creates a new UUID; failed/uncertain attempts are disclosed as counting toward five free attempts per24h.
Web sessionStorage is scoped to the verified profile; native SecureStore is scoped to the authenticated user.
Native load/save/clear operations are serialized per owner across component remounts in the same JS runtime; storage failure blocks submission.
Auth/profile transition, blur, unmount and late responses cannot update another active account or navigate to its predecessor result.
Historical total_money_recovered remains displayed as unverified; estimate is never presented as money received; wallet amounts and withdrawal rules are preserved.
